people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Yahweh will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies.
translations.bsb: The LORD extends Your mighty scepter from Zion: “Rule in the midst of Your enemies.”
translations.kjv: The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.
translations.asv: Jehovah will send forth the rod of thy strength out of Zion: Rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.
